heading: Mahua moves HC over cop inaction
author: Times News Network /  Sep 21, 2026, 21:41 IST
paragraphs: Kolkata: Mamata Trinamool MP Mahua Moitra on Monday moved the Calcutta High Court alleging police inaction following an egg pelting attack on her on Sept 16
